candidates.description: Lower numeracy is associated with a greater tendency to choose the suboptimal, large-numerator ratio option in competing affective decisions.
candidates.citation_sentence: Peters et al. (2006) conducted four studies and we aimed to replicate all of them with needed adjustments and collected in a single data collection, with the experiments displayed in a random order (more on that in the methods section).
candidates.notes: The replication did not reproduce the overall ratio-bias main effect, but it reproduced the predicted association between numeracy and bowl choice and the authors describe the numeracy finding as consistent with the original. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
